authorityNote: Source timeline assertions, owner corrections, and NEW PROVISIONAL DESIGN route rules are separate fields. Newly authored clues are fictional route content and are not recovered Equation fragments.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: First Choir formation and assault — contested timing
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: The original presents unnamed chords, invitation/formation and active seal repair before the direct scarlet-fire assault opening the Sundering. The owner says the First Choir arose in response to Asmodeus attacking Calanthir.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: Owner intent is recorded; exact event/awakening timing remains unresolved. Do not restore the withdrawn no-agency-before-assault or one-to-one Harmony mapping.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Pillar realms mature after the Sundering
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: The Planes Ascendant opening explicitly follows the Sundering and describes four differentiating realms; the next chapter begins with all four contributing to the Weave.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: This is relative narrative order, not a numbered-year or floor mapping.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Watch Convocation and aspirant gates
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: During the Lucent Interregnum, nascent divinity leads the Choir to open access to seven long-vacant Thrones. A gate appears at an unnamed Mirrorsage monastery library.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: The Thrones are described as older than this opening. The monastery has no supplied numbered floor; current gate availability is not selected.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Candescent Loom and Weave refraction
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: After the Argent Gate shines, the narrative describes small acts leaving visible intention records, called the Candescent Loom.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: A source episode does not automatically make every intention visible through current spells or provide a universal moral detection rule.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Pact sentience
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: Accumulated resonance gives the Pact a will distinct from a god or Choir chord in the narrative.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: Do not use this development to identify the Heartcell builder or assign a calendar date.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Archon sites and living records
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: Within the Pact-sentience chapter, Valcendyr forms the Oath Archive in Crystal Bastion and Quorilith establishes Library of Shifting Sigils.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: These are source-established events, with no chosen present-campaign access or Equation holdings.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Shardfall and Silver Prism Year
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: The Moment of First Scatter is called Shardfall; the ensuing Silver Prism Year has elastic length measured by transformed lives. Sixth Archive cartographers meet at Sigil Navigators Library.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: Do not convert the Year into one standard 400-day year or treat Sixth Archive as Floor 6. The library alias remains unresolved.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Epoch of Chosen Threads
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: The Silver Prism Year closes; scholars call the transition the Epoch of Chosen Threads. Community story keys can manifest resource-bearing Dungeon enclaves in the source.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: Epoch terminology supplies no fixed elapsed duration or automatically usable new portal mechanic.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Counter-expression and Unbound Academy
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: The Matrix broadcast prompts the Spiral Integral counter-expression. Quiet Wells later collapse and the Matrix equation fades; after the Sunrise of Chosen Threads a council builds the Unbound Academy.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: The narrative subsequently develops a renewed threat; this episode is not proof that all Oblivion danger has permanently ended or that Academy access is guaranteed now.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Quiet Masquerade and Citadel of Many Echoes
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: Following the Masquerade confrontation, the Academy and Yieldheart guilds build the Citadel at Crystalfall Summit. Its galleries preserve songs, prototypes and restricted chronicles; later the Matrix develops deliberate calculus.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: Do not merge the Citadel with a numbered dungeon floor or assume Selene’s foundation journal is freely accessible.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Matrix Horizon and imminent campaign
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: The Dawn Loom concert identifies the approaching Matrix Horizon. A later chapter places its arrival on the twentieth eve after the Citadel Vigil.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: The passage gives a relative marker, not a bridge to AE dating. Do not equate the Vigil with the Citadel’s founding date without evidence.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: High Chancel ascent
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: The fellowship ascends a ladder of living light toward the High Chancel to confront the Matrix edge.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: The route is not a normal descent to Floor 97 or Floor 100 merely because the same saga discusses the Dungeon.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Silent Library and Final Ledger
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: Inside the Matrix, the Silent Library tries to reduce cognition to zero. Memory-rope and song stabilize its books; the Final Ledger is answered and blanks before the walls open onward.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: Keep the encounter’s transformation. An untouched reusable library, a fixed floor or guaranteed access is not supplied.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Shard of Absolute Rest, victory and Charter
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: The black Shard of Absolute Rest splits; the Matrix curve scatters and Null breaches seal. The Charter of Infinite Yield follows. Ul nak’s dream recedes rather than vanishing; Stillness may try again in ages.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: Do not identify this shattered shard with Q6’s focusing crystal, or convert receding dream into death of the survivor/Old God. No identity bridge is established.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Explicit post-Proof-War epilogue
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: Movement One explicitly places its scene after the Proof War. Later movements give the Spiral cosmograph and Choir chorus around the Charter.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: The document’s later setting does not select the current campaign epoch. Map symbols and coils are not numbered dungeon floors.

sourceQualifiedTimeline.title: Epilogue toolbox and express portability
sourceQualifiedTimeline.sourceFinding: Dungeon seeds are headed after Infinite Yield, and three arcs continue beyond the epilogue. P324 expressly permits tables and relics to be used independently of the saga or in multi-era campaigns.
sourceQualifiedTimeline.currentLimit: Preserve both original placement and permission to adapt. Portability does not choose a floor, public truth, chronology or automatic mechanical replacement. Reuse the existing seventeen EPI groups.

mortalCalendar.newProvisionalTreatment: Use 710 AE as prospective current-cycle scheduling anchor; preserve 87 AE and the unexplained offset; do not backsolve primordial ages or Proof War.
mortalCalendar.clocks: Keep the existing Opening/Horn hour clocks exactly as current rules define them; this review creates no bridge from those clocks to AE, 400-day years, primordial Cycles, or elastic celestial measures.

campaignFrame.status: NEW PROVISIONAL FRAME RECOMMENDATION; NOT RECOVERED HISTORY
campaignFrame.recommended: Pre-Proof-War current campaign is the least disclosure-heavy default because it preserves the original forward saga as future/possible story material and the failed Sixth Gate public ceiling.
campaignFrame.whatMayRemainUnknown: Exact elapsed relation between 710 AE and cosmic saga chapters; precise public awareness of later original events; identities expressly left open by Q6/Heartcell reviews.
forbiddenMerges: Shard of Absolute Rest = focusing crystal

firstChoir.operativeTreatment: Owner correction controls the causal intent: the First Choir arose in response to Asmodeus attacking Calan'thir, and later virtues derive from that resonance. Preserve the original paragraphs showing seven nascent chords before the direct P39 assault and their invitation/formation scene; treat 'nascent chords', 'formal First Choir role/awakening', and the attack-response causal statement as distinguishable until the exact P35/P39 chronology is owner-edited. Do not restore a one-to-one Harmony mapping.
firstChoir.nineVersesTreatment: O279 says nine verses and 'one for each virtue plus the binding Variable Omega', while O280 supplies seven named virtue motif benefits. Seven virtue motifs are mechanically evidenced; Variable Omega is named in the song statement; one further verse/accounting element is not supplied. Preserve the mismatch. Do not invent an eighth virtue, an unnamed motif benefit, or call it a transcription error.

nodes.name: Cantor's Archive
nodes.access: Reach Floor 47 under ordinary Expedition/dungeon access; archive access itself may require Director-authored local permission, but this route does not invent a cosmic gate or bypass.

finiteEvidence.content: A finite catalog leaf compares five differently dated institutional copies of one non-Equation calibration event and explicitly marks two as later recopies. It contains no Equation fragment.
A bilingual marginal index preserves terminology equivalents only; it does not reveal lost formulas.

nodes.languageProtection: Use current language rules exactly. A reader who actually knows the script/language reads ordinary text directly; Translate/Decipher retains its existing eight-active-hour procedure. No generic subdivision permission is added. KT/PT protections and Corruption Ward use the current souls_research_reviewed_01 model only.
nodes.ordinaryTools: History can establish copy chronology; Arcana can classify magical notation without supplying missing content; Religion can distinguish doctrinal gloss from provenance; Engineering can identify catalog construction/repair layers; Nature is relevant only where material aging/environment is genuinely at issue.
nodes.authentication: Claimant of Record logs shelf mark, physical provenance, copy lineage, damage, and underlyingEvidenceId; cross-copy comparison can authenticate copying relationships but repeated copies do not become independent facts.

skillQuestion.question: Which of the five catalog witnesses can support relative ordering without assuming their copied dates are independent?
skillQuestion.outcomes: Use current fixed-DC four-degree task procedure with predeclared truthful outcomes.

nodes.boundedFinding: Successful work can establish a provenance relation among the finite witnesses and earn/advance a History qualification finding. It cannot date the Proof War, recover an Equation fragment, or resolve 87/710.
nodes.damageMissAlternative: If a key leaf is missing, the failure result records the missing lineage and points to RR02 or a mechanism receipt; no roll reconstructs absent text.
nodes.hazard: No automatic KT/PT merely for ordinary catalog handling. KT only if the work actually reaches a dangerous operational subprinciple under the current model.

nodes.name: Wax Library

placement.reason: O309 supplies Wax Library as a Dungeon seed; O324 expressly permits independent/multi-era use. Floor 68 is an authored placement for this candidate, not recovered source geography and not evidence that the seed originally stood there.

nodes.access: Ordinary Floor 68 route. The room's source seed retains the silent-reading premise: books melt when read aloud and are preserved through silent reading challenge. Any precise encounter DC is the candidate's preregistered task, not a recovered source number.

finiteEvidence.content: Twelve wax tablets survive; exactly four contain authenticated maintenance observations from different cycles, three are later teaching copies, five are damaged. None contains the Equation.
One heat-crazed wax seal embeds a nonmagical metal calibration tooth with a maker mark matching one maintenance tablet. The tooth is a provenance/engineering clue, not a formula fragment.

nodes.languageProtection: Silent reading does not waive language requirements. Real known-language benefits apply; Knowledge Transfer may temporarily provide a missing language/skill only for its actual one-hour window. Reading aloud risks the room's source-stated melting behavior.
nodes.authentication: Engineering comparison of maker mark/tooth dimensions plus History comparison to the four distinct maintenance observations. Same tablet copied twice remains one underlying evidence identity.

skillQuestion.question: Does the embedded calibration tooth support the same mechanism family described in the authenticated maintenance observations?

nodes.boundedFinding: May certify a mechanism-family relation and an Engineering qualification finding; cannot identify Heartcell builders or infer a cosmic institution.
nodes.damageMissAlternative: If tablets melt or are damaged, the metal tooth remains a rare physical receipt but cannot substitute for missing textual observations; a later distinct mechanism observation may replace the lost category.
nodes.hazard: Reading aloud can destroy candidate evidence. Dangerous operational understanding, not mere silence, governs KT. No hidden PT from the library absent level-5+ qualifying voice/proximity exposure.

nodes.name: Resonance Regulator Inspection

placement.location: a Director-placed accessible Dungeon mechanism on the route; no cosmic identity assigned

nodes.access: Physical access after ordinary dungeon navigation; no spell-based travel approval.

finiteEvidence.content: One regulator has three observable states—idle, loaded, and abort-safe—and a finite inspection plate. The plate contains labels, not Equation mathematics.
A safe test permits one bounded load pulse and one manual abort; repeat testing produces no new receipt unless conditions genuinely change.

nodes.languageProtection: Known labels can be read normally. If unknown, current language procedures apply. Corruption Ward only affects mechanically classified Corruption-effect saves under current rules; it does not authenticate the machine.
nodes.authentication: Direct observation plus maker/maintenance continuity from WL-OBS-01 if obtained; otherwise direct mechanism observation stands as its own receipt.

skillQuestion.discipline: Engineering or Arcana, chosen before work
skillQuestion.question: Which observed state transition reliably precedes the safe abort response?

nodes.boundedFinding: A supported state-transition finding usable in later Functional Model synthesis. It does not reveal who built the Heartcell or why.

predictionAbortTest.procedure: Before the bounded test, record three mutually exclusive observable outcomes for the chosen load pulse. Run one lawful test. If the preregistered abort condition occurs, abort immediately; aborted data may still authenticate what was actually observed but cannot be upgraded into an unobserved outcome.

nodes.hazard: An actual dangerous operational subprinciple can qualify for KT progression; a blind button press is an Execution Attempt record and does not manufacture understanding.

nodes.name: Seasonal / Change Observation

placement.anchor: uses the setting's existing ten-year Shardspire activation claim only as an observable change context; it does not resolve Shardspire origin

nodes.access: Schedule observation during a legitimately occurring change window chosen by the Director under the current 710-AE prospective campaign anchor. No primordial-cycle conversion.

finiteEvidence.content: One corresponding post-change observation of the same bounded indicator.

nodes.languageProtection: No language benefit is needed for raw observation; notes use the observer's actual language. Translation is only needed for external inscriptions/logs.
nodes.authentication: Same instrument/method, recorded world-clock timestamps, Routekeeper location, Claimant provenance, and no double-counting of one observation as two categories.

skillQuestion.discipline: Nature or Arcana, chosen by the phenomenon
skillQuestion.question: Did the preregistered indicator change across the defined window, and which of the three preregistered relations fits the observation?

nodes.boundedFinding: One seasonal/change receipt. It cannot prove a global cosmological cause.
nodes.missAlternative: If the window is missed, no retroactive roll recreates it. Use the next genuine occurrence or another authenticated change event.
nodes.hazard: PT applies only if the scene includes actual level-5+ qualifying voice/proximity exposure under current rules; ordinary seasonal observation is not automatically PT.

nodes.name: Rare Physical Corroborant

placement.location: finite dungeon reward/secured debris cache, not a recovered Equation fragment

nodes.access: Obtain through a normal authored encounter/reward or secure-site investigation; not guaranteed by a pending spell.

finiteEvidence.content: A single fractured alignment key has wear faces matching the RR03 regulator geometry and trace material matching WL-OBS-01's calibration tooth if that clue survived.

nodes.authentication: Engineering tool comparison plus provenance record; magical identification may describe actual magic if present but cannot invent lost history.

skillQuestion.question: Is PHYS-01 mechanically compatible with the observed regulator interface?

nodes.boundedFinding: One rare physical receipt and potentially a second genuinely distinct Engineering finding if the question/observation differs from prior findings.
nodes.missAlternative: If lost/destroyed, the route can continue gathering other findings but cannot satisfy the rare-physical Functional Model gate until another genuinely distinct authenticated rare physical clue is found.
nodes.hazard: No automatic taint from possessing the object.

nodes.name: Four-Hour Cross-Category Synthesis

placement.location: safe research site chosen by party

nodes.access: Lead must personally satisfy current Full Matrix Lead competence for every active synthesis interval: proficiency in Arcana, History, Religion, Nature, Engineering plus all five owned Advanced Qualification marks. A temporary lawful borrowed proficiency can satisfy the proficiency predicate only during its actual loan window; marks never transfer.
nodes.minimumReceipts: 2 distinct Descent libraries + 1 mechanism observation + 1 seasonal/change observation + 1 rare physical clue, all authenticated under current model.
nodes.workClock: 240 recorded active minutes, pausable. No rest/recast/travel/guard double-count. Four one-hour KT windows work only if each activation/recovery/world-time requirement is actually paid.
nodes.assistance: Up to three meaningful trained assistants, +1 each for the generic Expedition research task, subject to exact subprocedure limits; assistants never substitute for the lead's personal five-discipline qualification.

skillQuestion.discipline: lead declares one appropriate existing skill for the synthesis check
skillQuestion.recommendedDC: 10/15/20/25 band selected before rolling based on task difficulty; route default DC20 for integrating conflicting multi-source evidence

nodes.predictionAbortTest: Before any operational test, state three mutually exclusive observable predictions and the abort condition. A predicted relation can be tested; no real-world mathematics or recovered Equation text is required.
nodes.boundedFinding: A Functional Model about one supported relation among the route evidence. It is not the lost Equation, execution authority, cosmological identity proof, or spell approval.
nodes.hazard: If the Functional Model is a dangerous operational subprinciple, apply KT2 under the current model; later Demonstrated Operational Understanding can reach KT3. Execution/Hunt are separate records.
